risk: Servo pocket or shaft-offset dimensions in the CAD are wrong
cause_or_evidence: STS3215 shaft offset and STS3095 pocket were inferred from AM-ARM200 STLs, not measured
mitigation: Slotted adjustable carriers, pocket coupons, named CAD parameters

risk: Supply sags or trips when both STS3095 accelerate
cause_or_evidence: STS3095 stall current 9.8 A at 12 V; the 5 A supply on hand is too small; adapter board trace rating unknown
mitigation: 12 V 10 A supply, fuse and distribution block, 2200 uF bulk capacitor, signal-only through the Waveshare adapter, torque limit 40 % in first tests

risk: Z carriage creeps or drops when power is removed
cause_or_evidence: T8 screw is not self-locking; hold relies on a 24 V brake (assumed derating) and detent plus friction
mitigation: Brake motor, T8x4 screw, mechanical lower stop, no unattended operation until C3 passes

risk: Brake engagement transient cracks the carriage plate or nut ledge
cause_or_evidence: 108-172 N on the nut for 1-2 ms against a 5 MPa sustained allowable (6.4-10.2 MPa across layers)
mitigation: Ramp to zero before the brake sets; E-stop is the only hard-stop case; static 170 N test; thicker ledge if needed

risk: Open-loop tip error exceeds the lane funnel tolerance
cause_or_evidence: Servo backlash 0.5 deg gives 3.4 mm at 0.385 m; PETG compliance; calibration error
mitigation: Kinematic calibration, ArUco and depth correction before each insertion, entrance funnels; simulation tolerates 10 mm pick error

risk: Printed PETG links creep or flex; L1 torsion depends on the bonded cover
cause_or_evidence: FE: closed box 1.2-1.4 mrad per N*m against at least 24 for the open U; beam theory 3.6 mm droop bonded against 36-44 mm not bonded
mitigation: Bond the L1 and L2 covers (CA or epoxy bead plus screws), hang test, switch to ASA or PA-CF if droop exceeds 4 mm

risk: Pad friction lower than assumed, especially on wet bottles
cause_or_evidence: mu TPU-PET dry 0.8 and wet 0.4 are assumptions; wet 1 L needs 39 N against a 34 N command limit
mitigation: Measure; texture pads; command limits per SKU; v1 limited to SKUs that hold

risk: Camera fogs or fails when moved between cold and warm air
cause_or_evidence: Gemini 2 is specified 0-40 C non-condensing
mitigation: Keep it in the cold, warm-up and purge procedure, desiccant, heated window in v2

risk: Servo overheating or gear wear under repeated duty
cause_or_evidence: Hobby servos; rated torque is the continuous ceiling; duty cycle not tested
mitigation: Log temperature and load, soft limit 55 C, 10,000-cycle endurance before any pilot claim

risk: Bottle topples or stalls in a lane; lane flow is marginal
cause_or_evidence: Simulation: only mu 0.10 at 6 deg flows without toppling (3.4 s); mu 0.05 topples at every slope, mu 0.2 does not flow
mitigation: Measure lane friction first; PTFE or UHMW tape; shims 4-10 deg; entrance funnel; remote recovery with the leader arm

risk: Operator injury from pinch points or the falling carriage
cause_or_evidence: 4-DoF arm with 9.3 N*m peak joints, 4.5 kg moving mass on the column
mitigation: E-stop on the 24 V rail, torque and speed limits, guard at the column, no unattended operation in v1

risk: Mains wiring hazard
cause_or_evidence: Bench supplies, exposed terminals, condensation near electronics
mitigation: Certified supplies, enclosed terminals, fuse each rail, keep water away from connectors

risk: Real OXXO cooler geometry differs from the test fixture
cause_or_evidence: Shelf pitch, rear opening height and width, uprights, corridor depth and temperature are not measured. v1 needs 0.44 m level pitch (the gripper and L2 stack needs 130 mm above a grasped 600 mL bottle) and about 0.65 m of corridor depth behind the rear plane
mitigation: Photograph and measure one real rear-loaded cooler (inputs list); v2 low-profile wrist or wider pitch; the CAD is parametric

risk: 1.5 L, 2 L and larger SKUs do not fit or hold
cause_or_evidence: 47-63 N clamp needed against the 41.7 N cap; 2.5 L and 3 L exceed the jaw (125 mm) and the Z range; 2 L rear edge needs the relaxed 15 mm rule
mitigation: Scope v1 to cans, 500 mL and 600 mL (1 L at level 1); 1.5 L and 2 L as stretch with steel gears

risk: Product certification and electrical safety for a store
cause_or_evidence: Consumer-grade servos and supplies, no safety case
mitigation: Prototype only; accredited lab and risk assessment at product stage; not assessed here

risk: Simulation-to-real gap
cause_or_evidence: Rigid bodies, ideal servos, convex-hull arm, box fixtures, assumed masses and friction
mitigation: Treat simulation as a design check; calibrate friction and gains from the bench tests

risk: Retreat after release touches the neighbouring lane; capacity is capped
cause_or_evidence: Open gripper fingers sit 62-74 mm ahead of the wrist; default retreat contact-free 16/45; fully populated lanes 0/45 at any 90 mm pitch
mitigation: Bay rule (slots 0-1 of both neighbours empty): 45/45, 21 of 25 slots; v2 gripper with narrower rear fingers or lane pitch of at least 125 mm with a corridor retreat

risk: Level-0 margins are thin
cause_or_evidence: 600 mL lane 1 free lift 21.6 mm (CAD) against 13 mm needed; pitch can drop only about 6 mm; plate thickness and shim errors eat it
mitigation: Measure plate and bracket heights during assembly; keep rim at or below 11 mm; level 1 first

risk: 1 L tolerance in the 87 mm lane
cause_or_evidence: 2.5-5.5 mm per side; 8 of 60 draws hit a divider
mitigation: Lane clear width of at least 92 mm or a lead-in chamfer; 1 L at level 1 only

risk: Printed masses over budget
cause_or_evidence: Gripper 335 g against 250 g; L1 side 0.627 kg against 0.485; L2 side 0.303 against 0.195; J1 tilt moment 12.2 N*m
mitigation: Bearings carry the moment; lightening pass in the next revision; verify masses in A4

risk: Gear teeth bind in print
cause_or_evidence: Pinion-rack flank gap 0.082 mm in CAD
mitigation: Servo pocket adjusters, thin the pinion by 0.1 mm

risk: Cable routing is not designed
cause_or_evidence: Windows and grommets only in the arm; carriage plate has no cable path
mitigation: Design loops at J1, J2, J3 and the column before the first full run

risk: Assumed values behind the Z-module numbers
cause_or_evidence: Brake derating 50 %, detent 25 mN*m, bearing friction 10 mN*m, rotor inertia, TMC2209 current 1.4 A, rod and foot stiffness, 4040 inertia 8.14 cm4
mitigation: Measure in C1, C3, C5; replace the assumptions in zmod_inputs.json

risk: Structural checks are hand calculations and self-written voxel FE
cause_or_evidence: No commercial FEA; meshes 1.0-2.0 mm; open-U result not converged
mitigation: Hang and deflection tests on hardware; treat FE as screening

risk: Designed clearances are small
cause_or_evidence: 4.0 mm J1 pedestal top to camera bracket foot; 3.1 mm L1 J2 flange to the carriage plane at J1 = -20 deg; print warp can close them
mitigation: Check at assembly; limit J1 to 0..160 deg if needed

risk: Gripper torque register scale unverified
cause_or_evidence: The 1.177 N*m cap is about 400 of 1000 on the servo register by assumption; without it the pinion tip stress margin is 0.89
mitigation: Measure force against register (B2) before any bottle is clamped

risk: Corridor may be a cold room
cause_or_evidence: Rear corridors of walk-in coolers can sit at 2-6 C; electronics, PETG and TPU and the camera then work cold
mitigation: Fridge soak test; keep power electronics outside if possible

risk: Heat-set insert shortage
cause_or_evidence: 120-144 needed against 100 ordered
mitigation: Second pack in order batch 1 (done)

risk: Real shelf pitch is below what the v1 stack needs (v1 cannot serve 600 mL or larger PET in standard racks)
cause_or_evidence: Desk research (cooler_envelope_evidence.csv E01-E12): Anthony 5 shelves per door under 79 in, 6 at 79 in or taller, 7 on the 79 in Infinity MAX door, 7 on an 88 in B-O-F rack; even division gives pitches 0.287-0.381 m (inference, shelves adjustable). The v1 stack stands 140 mm above the object, so the gap above a 600 mL bottle (15-109 mm) is too small in all five configurations; v1.1 planner needs 0.407-0.434 m for 600 mL
mitigation: S2: offset wrist (L3 100 mm) with neck-jaw (15 mm above the cap, PET) and flat clamp (50 mm, cans); push-in transfer plate as fallback; v1 gripper kept as development tool; hold the level-0 fixture half and 90 mm lane plates until a rack mock-up with adjustable pitch (0.29-0.44 m) and 75 mm lane inserts exists; optional store survey (S1) stays available

risk: Container mass and pad friction differ from the SKU table (PET and cans only; glass and returnable are out of the plan)
cause_or_evidence: Liquid density spread is 4 %; printed TPU 95A friction in the literature spans 0.2-1.0 and nothing was found for wet PET at 4 C; the 1 L (1.072 kg) needs wet mu >= 0.38 at the 41.7 N cap; the 1 L default clamp (34 N) is 14 % short at wet mu 0.4
mitigation: Glass and returnable out of the plan (user decision 2026-10-02); design value 0.3 for printed pads; cast PU or silicone pads for the 1 L; form closure on the neck ring for PET (neck-jaw); 1 L commanded at the cap when wet; optional weigh-in and tilt test

risk: The arm cannot sense payload mass
cause_or_evidence: J1-J3 have vertical axes (no gravity torque) and the gripper register reads clamp torque, so a mis-identified heavy container is gripped like a light one
mitigation: SKU recognition plus the measured table; slip check at the first 5 mm lift with the wrist camera; optional load cell under the tote tray (not designed)

risk: Printed TPU friction on wet, cold PET is unknown (published values are dry, 0.2-1.0)
cause_or_evidence: Published coefficients for FFF TPU 95A are dry values on other surfaces (0.2-0.44 belt study, 0.47-1.0 ball-on-disc on steel); no wet PET at 4 C found; v1 assumed 0.4 wet; the design value 0.3 is an inference
mitigation: Design value 0.3; cast PU or silicone pads (target 0.4-0.5, assumed) for the 1 L; neck-jaw form closure for PET

risk: Lane clearance is smaller than the positioning error
cause_or_evidence: Glide lane 74.6 mm against the fixture's 90 mm; a 600 mL bottle (D 64-71) leaves 3.6-5 mm per side; servo backlash 0.5 deg is 3.4 mm at 0.385 m reach
mitigation: Wrist-camera feedback at the lane mouth, lead-in chamfers on the lane inserts, slow final approach, 75 mm lane inserts in the mock-up

risk: PCO-1881 neck and ring geometry varies
cause_or_evidence: Ring OD about 33 mm is ASSUMED (not retrieved); free neck below the ring unknown (3 mm jaw needs 4 mm); tamper bands, sports caps and non-PCO necks (30/25 water, 38 mm juice) exist
mitigation: Measure 5-10 bottles before cutting the jaw (H1); adjustable shims in the first print; non-PCO bottles go to the flat clamp

risk: A bottle hanging from the neck ring swings
cause_or_evidence: Neck-jaw holds by form closure; pitch swing about the ring under 0.3 g; liquid slosh not modelled
mitigation: Back stop and neck clamp (at least 10 N); accelerations at most 0.3 g while carrying; carry low; simulate in the S2 MuJoCo model

risk: J3 pin and flange see a moment they were not designed for
cause_or_evidence: S2 offset wrist loads J3 with 0.83 N*m (0.65 kg) to 1.25 N*m (1.07 kg) including a 0.2 kg tool; v1 J3 has the load on the axis
mitigation: Bearing housing with two 6701-2RS 30 mm apart (28-42 N per bearing) so the servo carries torque only; re-verify the pin and the flange; bar section 20 x 16 mm PETG or aluminium

risk: Rack height exceeds the Z range
cause_or_evidence: Racks are 1.9-2.2 m (5-7 shelves); the carriage reaches 0.37-1.06 m, i.e. 2-3 shelves
mitigation: v1 and the demo use two levels; a longer 4040 column and screw for production (not designed)

risk: Tote does not give horizontal access to necks
cause_or_evidence: The neck-jaw approaches horizontally; the v1 tote cells (pitch 85 mm) were designed for a top-down gripper
mitigation: Single-row tote tray, pitch at least 85 mm, open on the arm side

risk: Rack evidence comes from US catalogues and Mexican resellers, not from OXXO
cause_or_evidence: All pitches are inferred by even division of the door height; shelf positions are adjustable; T_struct 30 mm and the 5 mm margin are assumed
mitigation: Design to the range 0.287-0.381 m with 0.318 m driving; adjustable-pitch mock-up; optional store survey keeps the sheet ready; grades in cooler_envelope_evidence.csv
